question: Which of the following drugs is used to treat both diabetes mellitus and diabetes insipidus
analysis: Chlorpropamide is a sulfonylurea class drug primarily used to treat type 2 diabetes mellitus. It has also been used off-label to treat diabetes insipidus due to its ability to enhance the renal response to antidiuretic hormone, thereby reducing urine output. The other options, Glibenclamide, Glicazide, and Glipizide, are also sulfonylureas but are not used for diabetes insipidus.
